svg.title: Наклоны головы в стороны — положение 2
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow contour, vector traced. Gentle lateral neck bends, front view. Entire standing figures same square forward shoulders and relaxed arms. LEFT head tips modestly toward left shoulder, face still looks forward. RIGHT head tips modestly toward right shoulder, face still forward. Shoulders level, no rotation and no hand pressing the head. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
